meta.name: Holy Faak
meta.description:
Indra and Diya are back again with more drama and a hell lot of action. What happens when they find out that their grandparents got married?

Returning Series · First aired 26 Sept 2017 · India · Language: Bengali · 18 min
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 6/6

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Boy, Interrupted!
videos.overview: Diya and Indra's make out session goes for a toss at Monali's wedding; when Diya's rebellious sister Raima elopes to Mumbai.

videos.title: Just say Yes!
videos.overview: Furious, Diya's father Akhil decides to marry her off to prevent her from following Raima's footsteps. Indra proposes to Diya.

videos.title: Expiry Date
videos.overview: Diya breaks up with Indra, believing that "every relationship has an expiry date". An impulsive Indra also decides to get married within a week.

videos.title: The Grand Frandship!
videos.overview: Indra's grandfather Amit finds Diya's grandmother Labanya on Facebook. They befriend each other on Facebook and decide to meet.

videos.title: Frenemies
videos.overview: Indra and Biltu decide to seek revenge on Diya, leaving her shocked. Meanwhile, Amit and Labanya meet in the park and get along well.

videos.title: What goes in flies out
videos.overview: Hell-bent on revenge, Diya sends Indra a large box, that puts Indra to shame in front of guests. Meanwhile, Labanya and Amit's friendship becomes stronger.

videos.title: The beginning of the end
videos.overview: Everyone at Diya's home starts preparing for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya realizes she needs to meet Indra once. Will they patch up?

videos.title: Frame it Up
videos.overview: Indra is heartbroken after meeting Diya and realizes he should move on. However, he still hasn't met his soon-to-be wife..

videos.title: Faaked Up
videos.overview: Labanya and Amit plan a surprise for their grandchildren who are about to enter their new lives.

videos.title: Ei Biye My Foot!
videos.overview: It's time for Diya and Indra to face the surprise of their lives, that is even more shocking than discovering each other as bride and groom.

videos.title: Double Dhamaka
videos.overview: While trying to fix the situation, Indra and Diya fall prey to Amit and Labanya's current relationship status. The ex-lovers are now brother and sister.

videos.title: Byancho*
videos.overview: The inaccuracy in Labanya's behavior as a newly-wed bride arouses suspicion among youngsters. Are the grandparents plotting something?

videos.title: Chokhe Shorshe Phool
videos.overview: Indra and Diya decide to team up in order to churn out the truth from Amit and Labanya. Will it bring back the lost passion between them?

videos.title: Ghesha Gheshi My Ass!
videos.overview: While the youngsters are at a tug-of-war with their grandparents in order to hunt for the truth, love has taken the front seat for Indra and Diya.

videos.title: Dujonei Khub Fertile
videos.overview: Diya tries to trick everyone by saying she is pregnant and Indra is the father. Is she lying or is it for real? The finale episode has the answer.
